answer: For an available saved simple-chain coefficient s, annual PPR is catch C times s (divided by 9 once for tonnes C under the documented wet-weight convention). A genuine recorded C = 0 means no caught biomass, so its annual contribution is exactly 0 even when TL or s is unavailable. Keep those inputs missing; the zero contribution does not establish a coefficient. For positive catch, the missing coefficient prevents determining the contribution's magnitude, so PPR remains unavailable rather than zero. Missing catch also remains unknown. Missing coefficients confined to zero-catch taxa do not make the annual total incomplete; call a sum known simple-chain PPR only when unknown annual contributions remain.
